# cloudblast_server (Resource)

Manages a CloudBlast VPS server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudblast_server" "example" {
  plan_id     = 19
  location_id = 2
  template    = "ubuntu-24.04"
  hostname    = "example-server"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location_id` (Number) Data center location ID (see `cloudblast_locations` data source).
- `plan_id` (Number) Server plan ID (see `cloudblast_plans` data source).
- `template` (String) OS template slug (see `cloudblast_templates` data source).

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) Server hostname.
- `ssh_key_ids` (String) Comma-separated list of SSH key IDs to install during provisioning (e.g. `1,2,3`). Obtain IDs from `cloudblast_ssh_key` resources.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Server creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Server UUID.
- `ipv4` (String) Primary IPv4 address.
- `ipv6` (String) Primary IPv6 address.
- `os` (String) Operating system name.
- `root_password` (String, Sensitive) Root password (available after installation completes).
- `status` (String) Server status (installing, active, etc.).
